frontmatter.description: Orchestrate bounded Codex, Claude Code, Agy, Kimi, or custom CLI workers to finish work with the least lead context and provider usage, following playbooks such as plan big, execute small. Also use it proactively, without being asked, when a request is large enough to split into bounded independent units, such as a multi-file refactor, a migration, an audit or research across many files. Do not use for a small mechanical task unless explicitly requested.
